en: Proverbs 11

p.src: 1  A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

en: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
u.src: 1  A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

p.src: 2  When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

en: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
u.src: 2  When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

p.src: 3  The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
u.src: 3  The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

p.src: 4  Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

ja: も何の益にもならないが、
en: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
u.src: 4  Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

p.src: 5  The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

en: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
u.src: 5  The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

p.src: 6  The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
u.src: 6  The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

p.src: 7  When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

ja: び、 力にかけた期待も
en: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
u.src: 7  When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

p.src: 8  A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

ja: が代わってその中に陥る。
en: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
u.src: 8  A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

p.src: 9  With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

en: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
u.src: 9  With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

p.src: 10  When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
u.src: 10  When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

p.src: 11  By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

en: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
u.src: 11  By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

p.src: 12  One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

en: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
u.src: 12  One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

p.src: 13  One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

ja: らすが、 信頼できる
en: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
u.src: 13  One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

p.src: 14  Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

ja: 賢明な導きがなければ、
en: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
u.src: 14  Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

p.src: 15  He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

en: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
u.src: 15  He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

p.src: 16  A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

en: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
u.src: 16  A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

p.src: 17  The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

en: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
u.src: 17  The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

p.src: 18  Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

en: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
u.src: 18  Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

p.src: 19  He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

en: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
u.src: 19  He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

p.src: 20  Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

ja: のよこしまな者たちは
en: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
u.src: 20  Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

p.src: 21  Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

en: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
u.src: 21  Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

en: 11:21 or, seed

p.src: 22  Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

ja: のように、 分別を欠く美しい女も同じ。
en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
u.src: 22  Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

p.src: 23  The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

ja: いは良いことだけだが、 悪しき者を待ち受けるのは
en: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
u.src: 23  The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

p.src: 24  There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

ja: す者がいる。 与えるべきものまで
en: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
u.src: 24  There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

p.src: 25  The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

en: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
u.src: 25  The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

p.src: 26  People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

en: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
u.src: 26  People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

p.src: 27  He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

en: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
u.src: 27  He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

p.src: 28  He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

en: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
u.src: 28  He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

p.src: 29  He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

en: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
u.src: 29  He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

p.src: 30  The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

ja: であり、 知恵のある者は
en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
u.src: 30  The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

p.src: 31  Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

en: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
u.src: 31  Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
